question: Who was the first Indian to receive a Noble Prize? (RRB ALP (Electrician) (22/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: Rabindranath Tagore
C V Raman
Mother Teresa
Amartya Sen
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rabindranath Tagore

Explanation:
Rabindranath Tagore won the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1913, becoming the first Indian to receive a Nobel Prize. He was honored for his work "Gitanjali", which was published in English translation. Tagore was a poet, writer, composer, and painter who enriched Indian literature and culture. He was born on 7 May 1861 in Kolkata. He was also the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature. This award brought international recognition to India. Later, other Indians including C.V. Raman, Mother Teresa, and Amartya Sen also won Nobel Prizes.
